name: xiaobei-harmony-mcp

tools.name: xiaobei_get_connection_status
tools.description: Check this Xiaobei connection without re-pairing. Defaults to a fast local snapshot, not proof that the phone is online. Set probe=true for one read-only LAN readiness check with a 3-second deadline; it never overlaps an active operation. Use connect=true to resume first pairing, an explicit reconnect request, or recover the saved LAN address. After pairing, refresh the MCP tool list. A successful probe does not confirm a previous action outcome. Follow recovery.nextAction; never infer phone freezing from a timeout.

probe.description: Run one short read-only phone probe; no cloud resolution, pairing or browser.

connect.description: Explicitly start/resume the existing pairing or saved-address recovery flow. May open the pairing page or contact the hub; does not replace an authorization without phone approval.

instructions:
手机自动化任务结束时，先核对业务结果并保存需要的截图，再调用 mobile_return_to_xiaobei，确认小贝已回到前台后报告任务结果。取消任务且已无待处理操作时也可收尾。若用户明确要求停留目标页面，或正在等待验证码、登录及其他必须在该页面完成的用户操作，则保留页面。该工具只确认返回小贝，不证明业务任务成功，不保证熄屏、锁屏或再次切后台后的可达性；手机已冻结时请用户手动打开小贝，不要重新配对或重做已完成的操作。
连接异常时按错误结果 nextAction 处理，不要只反复等待。retryable 仅指原调用可安全重试，按 retryAfterMs 等待且最多额外重试 maxRetries 次；达到上限立即说明阻塞原因。executionState=unknown 时先核对当前页面，禁止直接重发点击、输入或批量操作。需要用户操作时明确提示并停止循环。xiaobei_get_connection_status 默认只看本地状态；probe=true 做一次短时局域网检查，不代表此前业务操作成功。状态或错误中的缓存信息不代表实时授权；超时不能证明系统冻结。首次没有手机工具时调用 xiaobei_get_connection_status({connect:true}) 恢复原配对流程；手机工具列表变化后重新获取列表，客户端未刷新时重新连接小贝 MCP，不重新扫码。
